timing_scope: Isolated processes; batch 1; 4096 tokens (4095 shifted targets); group-4 decoder checkpoints; 128-token head; 10 warmup and 100 recorded updates. Tokenization/data loading and model construction are outside the step timer. ONNX execution, exchange and AdamW are recorded separately. GPU work is synchronized.
storage_scope: Identical NF4-rounded decoder values. ONNX stores packed lookup-4 weights; PyTorch MPS stores dequantized dense weights. FP32 master adapters, gradients and AdamW state; BF16 cases round projection operands/results with FP32 adjoints.
memory_scope: Whole-process macOS physical footprint including setup, runtime and allocator caches; RSS and MLX active/cache/peak counters retained. Score-matrix budget 1 GiB; provider allocator limit 20 GiB; no explicit idle-cache limit in primary runs.
comparison_policy: Today's existing 100-sample MPS baselines have identical input hashes, versions, precision and workload settings. Fresh three-sample MPS repeats are retained alongside them.
